name: How do you protect my belongings and flooring during interior painting?

mainEntity.name: How do you protect my belongings and flooring during interior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Protecting your belongings and flooring is a top priority during interior painting. This involves meticulously covering all furniture with plastic sheeting, taping off baseboards, and laying down drop cloths on floors. Any fixtures or hardware that cannot be removed will also be carefully masked. For homes in the East Bay or Berkeley, where many residences have unique architectural details, extra care is taken to safeguard delicate features. Our team ensures that your property is completely protected before any paint is applied, and conducts a thorough cleanup afterward.
acceptedAnswer.description: We protect belongings and flooring by covering furniture, taping baseboards, and using drop cloths. Special care is taken for unique architectural details common in local homes.
